# 🌡️ ±0.4 °C Reference vs ±3 °C Line Fallout: 12 Issues (2 Blocker) — Temperature Sensor Verification Scheme Cleared "Conditional Pass", Fixtures Released in Parallel

**⚡ 30-second TL;DR**
1. **Do not import the new sensor into OTP yet.** Keep OTP as-is, add **two reference sensors** (newly purchased + existing in-house) and log their values alongside the original sensor in the test log — this is the only way to detect whether the **±0.4 °C** OTP calibration reference has drifted.
2. **The tolerance chain does not close:** board NTC spread **1 °C** (Maple EVT thermocouple) → Cosmo limit **±3** → Maple limit **±4** → finished goods **±7** → line complaint **±3**. Any move by Ayesha to compress **±4** back is **blocked until station-by-station data exists**.
3. **Two Blockers:** no calibration record for the OTP **±0.4** reference, and no in-house reference more accurate than the claimed **±0.2 / ±0.3 °C** new sensor. All verification must close **before Oak (奥克) EVT**; fixture fabrication (**ODBMCUBMS**) is **not** gated.

**Key points:** 25 sequenced events; only one hard clock time (13:30) and one hard gate (before Oak EVT) exist in the source.
**Conclusion:** The meeting produced a method and a gate, but no dates, no owners for calibration/yield data, and no answer on the OTP calibration record.
**Next actions:** Convert the two summary actions + dwell rule into a dated, owned plan (see Module 8).

### 3.4 Measurement-capability analysis **[Inferred — engineering note, requires approval]**

| Item | Statement in meeting | Engineering reading (inferred, **not a meeting conclusion**) |
|---|---|---|
| "±0.5 ref vs ±0.2 DUT → difference ±0.3" | E03 | **±0.3 is the difference of the two accuracy specs.** The worst-case **reading spread** between two instruments is the **sum**: 0.5 + 0.2 = **±0.7 °C** (RSS ≈ ±0.54 °C). Acceptance windows in Module 7 must use the **sum**, not the difference. **[To check with chair]** |
| Screening vs calibration | ±0.5 ref accepted "用来做评估" | Valid for **incoming relative screening**; **not** valid as a calibration reference for a ±0.2 DUT (reference must be better than the DUT — stated rule). |
| Test uncertainty ratio (TUR) | Not discussed | With ±0.5 ref vs ±0.2 DUT, TUR ≈ **0.4 : 1** (inverted). A conventional 4:1 TUR would need a reference of about **±0.05 °C**. **[Inferred target — TBC]** |
| Guard band ±3 → ±4 | 1 °C board spread justified +1 | Arithmetically consistent **as stated**; but the raw thermocouple dataset is missing (m1), so the justification is currently **not auditable**. |

### 7.4 验证执行流程

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A[新 sensor 到货 型号与SN待补] --> B[登记设备台账 含精度与证书]
    B --> C[双参考同位置比对 新购 加 已有或自制 加 热电偶]
    C --> D[驻留 30 分钟至 2 小时 记录环境温度曲线]
    D --> E{三方差值是否满足阈值 阈值待确认}
    E -- 否 --> F[判为来料或参考异常 不得导入 复测或换件]
    E -- 是 --> G[分工站铺开 PCBA semi park 1 semi park 2 Pack 2 MCU BMS]
    G --> H[OTP 保持原样 仅新增参考 sensor 并写入测试 log]
    H --> I[新旧 log 比对 判断原 sensor 是否漂移]
    I --> J{OTP 校准是否可信}
    J -- 否 --> K[触发 BL-01 复校并出具校准清单]
    J -- 是 --> L[汇总数据 支撑 limits 决策 D-06]
    K --> L
    L --> M[奥克 EVT 前完成 输出报告与校准清单]
```

【重点】验证方案三要素已定：**双参考、同位置、长驻留（建议 2h）**；OTP 采用「不动原样 + 记 log」的无损监测法。
【结论】方法可执行，但**全部判定阈值仍为[待确认]**，无阈值即无法判定通过与否。
【下一步】在 MJ-05 计划中一并固化阈值、测点、样本量与数据模板。

**预放电（Pre-Discharge）**：电池包对外输出前，先经小电流回路给车辆控制器电容充电，避免大电流冲击；FATP 用电子负载模拟该过程，**规格 750mA** 即要求包能提供足够的预放电电流。 - **BJT 的作用**：作为预放电回路的电流放大/开关器件，其 **HFE（放大倍数）** 偏低时可提供的电流不足 → 预放电电压差建立失败 → 触发保护 → 测试 NG【推断：基于邮件「放大不足」「电压 delta 保护」的机理解释】。 - **0402 电阻（45k / 99k / 204k / 450k / 15k）**：预放电支路限流电阻，阻值越大电流越小；换阻值需**拆保护板返工 4 颗电阻**，因此测试非常耗时。 - **e-load（电子负载）**：PRODIGIT 3311F 与 Chroma 63203A 的 **Von（导通门槛电压）** ## 3.1 S56 → DP420 切换（最重要议题）

- **观点（客户方）**：这是 running change，不是 cut-in；S56 用完再切 DP420，导入时点按 forecast 用量推算。
  **依据**：原话“用完56再再切20，所以你基于 forecast 用量可以什么时候可导入”。
- **观点（客户方）**：虽然设备 buy-off 已过，但“跑一跑”仍可能出问题，**必须先小量**；批量与内部安排由厂方内部讨论决定。
  **依据**：“please do the 30 pieces. In the beginning and if you don't see any issue, you guys can implement the rest”＋“你们内部可以讨论一下看怎做”。
- **分歧/未对齐**：同一议题出现两个批量口径——**30 pcs**（P10）与 **首轮 FAI＋3 pcs**（P11）。会中未澄清是“先 3 pcs FAI 再补至 30 pcs”还是二选一。→ 列入 U2，禁止按任一数字对外承诺。
- **观点（客户方，Che【待确认】提示）**：DP420 消耗速度快于 S56，风险窗口更短，故 **首周 IE＋QE 驻线**；S56 保留每 2 小时巡检。
  **依据**：“because of the DP for20 occurring quicker than the S56 … for the first week we have to get the Ie and the QE come to the lie”。
- **前置条件（客户方，厂方接受）**：导入前更新 WI/SOP 等资料并通知相关方；首轮结果需客户 approval 后才进量产。
